name: Remove
expect: [None, None, None, True, False, True, True, False]
expr: (lambda S: [getattr(S, op[0])(*op[1:]) for op in args[0]])(free(SkipList()))
why: remove returns True when the key was there, then False the second time: [None, None, None, True, False, True, True, False]. 4 must be unlinked on every level of its tower.

name: Negative keys
expr: (lambda S: [getattr(S, op[0])(*op[1:]) for op in args[0]])(free(SkipList()))
why: [None, None, None, -5, -12, True]. The head's key is None, so never compare it.

name: The shape
expr: (lambda S: [[S.add(k) for k in args[0]], (lambda c: [c[0], 0.4 < c[1] / c[0] < 0.6, 0.15 < c[2] / c[0] < 0.35])(skip_counts(S))][1])(free(SkipList()))
show: add 20,000 keys, then count the nodes on levels 0, 1 and 2: [level 0 count, about half on level 1?, about a quarter on level 2?]
why: Level 0 must hold all 20,000 keys. A key should go up one more level on each heads of a fair coin, so about 1/2 of the keys reach level 1 and 1/4 reach level 2. Use random.random() < 0.5.

name: Big
expr: (lambda S: [[S.add(k) for k in args[0]], [S.remove(k) for k in args[0][::3]], [sum(S.contains(k) for k in range(0, 60_000, 7)), sum(x for x in (S.first_at_least(k) for k in range(5, 60_000, 11)) if x is not None)]][2])(free(SkipList()))
show: add 30,000 keys, remove every third one, then 8,572 contains and 5,455 first_at_least queries: [how many found, sum of the answers]
why: Each operation should take O(log n) on average. If this timed out, the search may walk along level 0 only, which is O(n).
